novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new cross-type relationship—“a reproducible localization spectrum: factual → most localized/MLP-driven/mid-layer; conceptual and relational → more distributed/attention-driven; procedural → latest-layer, serial”—rather than merely a new model or dataset. Searches using “LLM factual conceptual relational procedural knowledge localization,” “entity relational knowledge MLP attention,” and “procedural knowledge layer localization language model” identify the closest prior work as Does Knowledge Localization Hold True? Surprising Differences Between Entity and Relation Perspectives in Language Models (2024), which already contrasts entity and relational storage and reports relational knowledge in attention, alongside Geva et al.’s factual-recall localization work; however, these do not establish the proposed four-way spectrum or its procedural late-layer endpoint. Moving from those studies to a matched factual/conceptual/relational/procedural comparison is a substantive multi-step integration and new operational unit of analysis, but much of the predicted factual-versus-relational direction and the probing/patching methodology are natural extensions of existing findings rather than a new mechanistic paradigm.
